notes: CONFORMS (2026-11-16, kb/Work PB5886 with its review rounds 1 and 2): §2023:15.3 AR6 'An arithmetic expression that will always result in an integer value or an integer data item shall be specified' (cite.py OK). The type 6 screen FAILS CLOSED (IntegerViolation's expression arm, NotAlwaysIntegral; the PB124 witness arms, the PB617 constant witness and their fail-open residue are gone). It admits only what it shows to be an integer for every valuation, by the types of the terms and the values of the literals: an integer term (ProvablyIntegral: an integer literal or exact literal fold, an integer data item, a function of the integer type its definition's table gives for the argument types written, IntrinsicResultType.Resolve, held to the §15.x.1 tables by IntrinsicResultTypeDriftTests; +, -, * and unary - over integer terms; an integer term to an exponent that cannot be negative and the literal 1 to any integer exponent, IsIntegerPower); a quotient by a literal whose reciprocal terminates, read as the product by that reciprocal; and a sum of items under literal factors whose net coefficient the item's scale makes whole (CollectAdditive). The literal terms must sum to an integer: CHAR(1.5 + 1) is refused, CHAR(1.5 + 0.5) admitted (the fold is exact and kept only when the arithmetic stores every quotient in it, QuotientsAreExact). Everything else is refused with COBOL1627: a numeric function term, an integer term under a fractional net factor (FACTORIAL (FUNCTION ORD (A) / 2)), a quotient by an item (I / I, 362880 / D9), a quotient by a literal whose reciprocal does not terminate (WN / 3 * 3), a power with an exponent that can be negative. A form that is an integer only by an identity between numeric function terms (SQRT (N) - SQRT (N) + 5) is refused as recorded debt (kb/Work PB5889). The same classifier, IsAlwaysIntegral, answers the argument types of the functions whose type depends on them, so MAX (WN / 2 * 2) is an integer function (IsIntegerArgument; IntegralForm gives such an argument its scale-0 value through INTEGER-PART). Witnesses: the pb5886-* refusals and pb5889-identity-difference, the complements pb5886_integer_term_shapes, pb5832_scaled_integral_shapes, pb124_always_integral_zoo, pb617_integer_arg_literal_constant, the unit shape table IntrinsicTypeSixPowerShapesDriftTests and IntegerArgumentConstantWitnessTests.
